description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield and allowing each opponent to return a creature from their graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
